title: PHP agent signing key fingerprints
description: Fingerprints of the keys that sign PHP agent packages.

first_signed_version.description: First version whose tarballs were signed by the release pipeline.

keys.description: The keys, with exactly one active key whose purpose is tarball (a key without status is active). validate.py requires one active key for each of apt and rpm too. A key that is replaced stays in the list with the status retired, for as long as anything it signed can be downloaded.

expires.description: A date or the word never.

fingerprint.description: Full fingerprint, 40 upper-case hexadecimal digits without spaces.

public_key_url.description: https on download.newrelic.com, a path of letters, digits, / _ . and -, and the extension .public, or .gpg for the legacy key (no whitespace or control characters).

status.description: active (the default when the field is absent) or retired. A retired key is no longer used for new releases; it stays listed so that older releases can still be checked against a published fingerprint.
